We're hiring a Unity Developer!

Join us on a mission to musicalize the world through innovative, music-driven games. You'll turn bold ideas into polished, playable experiences using Unity. Were looking for someone whos solid with Unity programming, knows how to work with sound and music, and thrives on learning and pushing creative boundaries. If you're passionate about making great games and love solving problems, we want to hear from you.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Work on popular music games with millions of users daily
• Work by stories/tasks and product priorities.
• You are a member of our Scrum teams
• Brainstorm to make clear game ideas, and find technical solutions for any game features
• Review & standardize codes for the development team
• R&D game technologies based on product requirements.
• Support other members about technology and game logic solutions
• Use Git to control your work.
• Self-manage tasks and processes using the JIRA tool
• Always be available when the product has issues

QUALIFICATIONS
• Experienced in working in Unity game development
• Experienced in giving solutions to build game systems or any cool features from product requirements.
• Experienced in software development with Agile/Scrum method

Will be plus

• Experienced in designing frameworks for multiplay
• Experienced in writing extra native codes (C /C++/ Java/ or Object C)
• Knowledge about programming, and game engines.
• Time management
• Troubleshooting skills, strong logical thinking, solve problems creatively and effectively.
• Leadership/ownership.
• Product mindset in games development
• Game passion, Music passion
• Discipline

WHAT WE OFFER
• Competitive salary, 100% salary during probation
• Performance bonus with 30% of company profit shared with no cap
• Full SHUI as Vietnamese Law + Premium Private Medical Insurance and annual health check
• Minimum 12 days paid annual leave + 10 days paid sick leave.
• 12 days working from home per year
• Annual flexi-budget (9.400.000 VNĐ/year) for well-being & personal development
• Free daily lunch with 10+ menu options.
• Free daily F&B: Snacks, juice, beverage, tea-time
• Monthly/Bi-monthly team activity allowance
• Company learning trip will be top of countries that we gain most profit. 1st is Korea, next destination is Japan
• Sponsored sports activities: badminton, soccer, ...
• Sponsored overseas conferences and industry events for all levels.
• Modern equipments/AI tool provided.
How To Apply?

Click the button or contact us at talents@uplive.zone
